additional_info.subject: RE: ID0407622-DC/SI-D/FR-[Y2/ PD 312571675/23]-TPE Issue CRM:01282000850
additional_info.body:
Hello RC-FR,
We are moving the below case to emobility RC-FR queue for below checks and steps:
Ensure the terminal is properly connected to its power supply. Check the wirings to CCV light and 24V power supplies to terminal. A loss of power can cause the terminal screen to go blank. Try restarting the payment terminal by turning the charger off and on again. This can sometimes resolve temporary glitches.
Inspect the terminal connection any loose or damaged cables.
Sometimes, dirt in the connectors can affect functionality.
Test another terminal (if available): If possible, try using a different payment terminal (if your setup has more than one). This can help identify whether the issue is specific to that terminal or a wider system fault.
If the issue persists, carry a spare along for replacement.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavy Gurav
